All of this is the first screen of the DEFAULT boot mode on both form factors. Also observed: backdrop inconsistency persists and flipped — fresh c02-mode-canvas now shows the bare gray stage where the 23:52 capture of the same view showed the neon backdrop, while fresh mobile-1 now shows the neon backdrop at boot. No fresh console/results JSON accompanied the recapture; the zero-console-errors claim is asserted, not bundled — my own measurements are frame-based.
